title: Independent SSR blind-review result
description: One record per reviewed bug state, written by one reviewer. The fine-grained failure_pattern enum and the failure_scope enum are taken unchanged from frozen AIDev taxonomy v1. Broad families are NOT recorded here: they are derived deterministically afterwards by scripts/apply_frozen_families.py.

bug_id.description: The neutral packet identifier, SSR_001 to SSR_100.

failure_pattern.description: Fine-grained label from frozen AIDev taxonomy v1, unchanged. UNASSIGNED is deliberately absent: every case in this study is an execution-validated technical bug state, so the non-technical escape hatch cannot apply. Use OTHER_TECHNICAL_PATTERN when no defined pattern fits.

failure_scope.description: Unchanged from AIDev v1. Under the frozen code-state-precedence rule, a case where both a code-state pattern and a verification-process pattern apply takes the code-state pattern as failure_pattern and records the verification facet here as BOTH.

supporting_evidence_ids.description: Must be a subset of the evidence_ids listed in the packet. Checked by scripts/validate_review_output.py.

reasoning_summary.description: Short evidence-based justification. Never private chain-of-thought.
